title: TyPatch: Transforming Patches into Typestate Rules for Kernel Bug Detection
abstract: arXiv:2609.13728v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Historical Linux kernel patches capture defect knowledge that applies beyond their original repair sites. Recent work has shown that large language models (LLMs) can generate static-analysis checkers from historical patches and use them to uncover new kernel bugs. However, complete-checker generation requires the model both to recover the defect semantics expressed by a patch and to implement sophisticated program-analysis machinery, including object tracking, alias analysis, path-state maintenance, and interprocedural propagation. Coupling these responsibilities in a single end-to-end code-generation task can turn a simple defect rule into an unstable and expensive analyzer-implementation problem.   To address this problem, we present TyPatch, which decouples patch-specific defect semantics from analyzer implementation. translated_title: TyPatch：将补丁转化为类型态规则以检测内核缺陷
translated_abstract: 历史上的Linux内核补丁蕴含着可应用于原始修复点之外的缺陷知识。近期研究表明，大语言模型（LLM）能够从历史补丁中生成静态分析检查器，并用它们发现新的内核缺陷。然而，生成完整的检查器要求模型既能恢复补丁所表达的缺陷语义，又要实现复杂的程序分析机制，包括对象跟踪、别名分析、路径状态维护和过程间传播。将这些职责耦合在单一的端到端代码生成任务中，可能使一个简单的缺陷规则变成一个不稳定且代价高昂的分析器实现问题。为解决这一问题，我们提出了TyPatch，它将补丁特有的缺陷语义与分析器实现解耦。LLM将每个补丁翻译为一条类型态规则，指定其被跟踪对象、动作、守卫条件、状态转换以及（原文截断）
tldr: TyPatch提出将内核补丁通过LLM转化为类型态规则，把缺陷语义与分析器实现解耦，从而更稳定高效地检测新的内核缺陷。
en_tdlr: TyPatch transforms kernel patches into typestate rules via LLMs, decoupling defect semantics from analyzer implementation to enable stable and efficient detection of new kernel bugs.
